absolute_deadline_persistence.storage: Deadlines are persisted as absolute timestamps in PostgreSQL (match.matches.deadline)
absolute_deadline_persistence.persistence: Reconnecting, re-reading with core.readMatch, or reading from a fresh Core service returns the exact same absolute timestamp; elapsed time reduces remaining time and never grants a fresh turn duration

premature_timeout_rejection.enforcement: Calling timeout before deadline throws NOT_TIMED_OUT and rolls back completely; leaves zero outcome rows, zero outbox events, and match status remains PLAYING

due_timeout_settlement.settlement: Past deadline, checkTimeouts executes core.run; match settles with reason 'timeout', winner awarded to opponent of current turn, receipt emitted, outbox event enqueued; operates correctly even after total Redis namespace wipe

move_vs_timeout_race_serialization.serialization: A move committed near deadline advances revision to N+1 and resets deadline to now + turnSeconds*1000; a timeout claim for revision N throws NOT_TIMED_OUT or MATCH_CLOSED and cannot settle the new revision
move_vs_timeout_race_serialization.concurrency: Concurrent move and timeout commit exactly one effect under aggregate identity and actor locks; match is never split or double-settled

idempotent_timeout_replay.replay: Same timeout key returns the stored settlement receipt without duplicate payouts, double burns, or outbox duplication

offer_expiry.mechanism: reapDueRooms expires OFFERED matches past their offer window using deterministic expire:<matchId> command
